parsed.title: Respond to Customer Queries via Email

steps.description: Check email inbox for new customer inquiries.
Read and acknowledge each inquiry promptly.
Gather necessary information about the issue.
Provide a clear and concise response addressing the query.
Close the case once resolved.
Answer incoming phone calls during business hours.
Listen carefully to customer concerns and provide assistance.
Record details of the conversation if needed.
Transfer calls to appropriate team members when required.
Follow up with customers after handling their queries.

parsed.title: Review and Resolve Tickets via Ticketing System

steps.description: Access the company's ticket management system.
Search for open tickets related to customer issues.
Review all relevant information associated with each ticket.
Prioritize tickets based on urgency and importance.
Resolve tickets by assigning them to the correct department or individual.
Document resolutions and follow-ups within the ticket system.
Arrive on time for scheduled weekly meetings.
Listen actively to updates from other team members.
Participate in discussions and ask clarifying questions.
Take notes during meetings and share insights with colleagues.
Prepare for next week's meeting agenda.
Schedule regular check-ins with external partners.
Discuss ongoing projects and progress.
Address any issues or challenges that arise.
Agree on next steps and deadlines.
Ensure timely delivery of deliverables according to agreed-upon timelines.
Sign up for industry newsletters and attend webinars.
Set aside time each day to read articles and reports.
Create a personal knowledge base of key trends and best practices.
Share insights gained from reading with team members.
Regularly update the team on emerging trends and potential impacts.
